patch:
@@ -398,6 +398,19 @@ jobs:
             exit 1
           fi
           printf '%s\n' "${assets[@]}"
+      # SHA256SUMS.txt lists every published asset in sha256sum's own
+      # format ("<hash>  <file>"), so a download can be checked with
+      # `sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS.txt`, and launchers that
+      # install CamCraft (ArtCraft Launcher requires it) can verify it.
+      - name: SHA256SUMS.txt for the assets
+        shell: bash
+        working-directory: dist
+        run: |
+          shopt -s nullglob
+          assets=(*.zip *-setup.exe *.tar.gz *.deb *.rpm *.dmg *.AppImage *.snap *.flatpak *.pkg.tar.zst)
+          sha256sum -- "${assets[@]}" > SHA256SUMS.txt
+          sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
+          cat SHA256SUMS.txt
       - name: Publish GitHub Release
         uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
         with:
@@ -412,6 +425,7 @@ jobs:
             dist/*.snap
             dist/*.flatpak
             dist/*.pkg.tar.zst
+            dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
           body_path: dist/release-body.md
           # A failed platform leaves its globs empty; the step above already
           # refused a release with no asset at all.
